inference_ms.method: k_cycle_get_32 around the inference call, cross-checked against a wall-clock A/B of both builds; the host script's line-gap method is unreliable once inference is fast

verification.reference_kernels: OpResolverType.BUILTIN_REF (XNNPACK does not reproduce reference int8 arithmetic)

primary_model.variant: domain-hardened + low-light hardened (3 synthetic photographic views per pictogram image; sensor-model night augmentation on 22 % of samples)

errors.pairs: class 83 <-> 84 (steep descent / steep ascent), the mirror pair

confidence.meaning: organisers confirmed the reported confidence IS the accuracy criterion
confidence.method: softmax over dequantised int8 logits, output side only

temperature_scaling.reason: erases the separation between the wrong prediction and the correct ones, and would be fitted on the same 364 images used for checkpoint selection

training.note: validation exceeds training because augmentation is applied to the training stream only

changes: convolution fused with the following 2x2 max pool - the wide intermediate tensor is never materialised
uint8 activation representation removes the zero-point subtraction from the inner loop
four output channels accumulated per pass

domain_robustness.stress_set: src/stress_set.py - pictogram classes composited onto photographic backgrounds with perspective, blur, JPEG and lighting variation

low_light.generator: src/lowlight_set.py - alpha blend with black, and a physically based sensor model at matched brightness
low_light.note: blend-to-black overstates robustness because it omits shot noise; the two agree until noise dominates, then diverge

model_selection.rationale: validation is the only genuinely held-out set; the stress and night sets are our own constructions. The shipped model wins on the real holdout and dominates the in-distribution model everywhere.

arena_bytes.note: triple fusion verified byte-identical on all 364x17 int8 logits against the pair-fused schedule

esp32s3.source: Zephyr memory report from a build of this exact tree, 31 Aug 2026; never flashed

hardware.part: ESP32-D0WD-V3 (Xtensa LX6), 4 MB flash, CH340 USB-serial, 115200 8N1
hardware.status: bench proxy - the submitted target is ESP32-S3, built and linked but never flashed

single_error.note: identical index and misclassification as native x86 and QEMU

hardware.link_errors: zero re-sends across the 364-image sweep. One frame was rejected during bring-up (ERROR odd number of hex digits) while a terminal emulator still held the port; one event, not a measured rate

_note: Figures re-verified 2026-09-02 against model/quantized_model_int8.tflite and the C runtime in src/qemu_app/src/. Scripts that reproduce each block are named in docs/RESULTS.md.

runtime.dependencies: none beyond <stdint.h> and <string.h>; no heap, no framework, no operator registry
